findings.title: Step outputs inherit the final route purpose, obscuring evidence stage
findings.observation: All 47 output purpose fields equal their route target artifact. In S07 the first dialectic step already calls its output an observation with support limits and unresolved confounders, while the experiment that produces an observation is the second step.

counterexample.observed_or_supplied_case: The frozen S07 route names an observation as its s1 output purpose before its toy experiment step.
counterexample.failure_observation: A consumer using purpose alone cannot distinguish a prediction from a newly measured result.
counterexample.same_problem_applicability: Decision quality depends on preserving prediction-versus-observation provenance.
counterexample.limitations: Output kind, capability, and expected_output_contract partly disambiguate; no executor was observed misclassifying an output.

attack_to_expand.assumption: A route-level purpose is adequate as every step's evidence contract.
attack_to_expand.opening: Separate the evidence state from the chosen capability.
candidates: Use phase-specific outputs: hypothesis ledger, raw observations, then bounded inference.
Let one investigator produce a compact claim-to-observation record without a route template.
Retain the rich route but require a provenance ledger shared by all steps.
attack_to_expand.test: Give readers only the step artifact and require them to identify predicted versus observed claims; compare current and repaired contracts.

findings.repair: Bind each executed output to a stage-specific purpose and evidence-state field; preserve original draft separately.

findings.title: The S10 equality checklist omits an obligation present in its own pass gate
findings.observation: S10's representation-sync condition and human lane require equal meanings for evidence. Its lane_sync_contract.required_equal_fields lists outcome, constraints, exclusions, and unresolved_claims, omitting evidence.
evidence: inputs/STRATEGIES.md#S10. Compare the human need with the machine representation

counterexample.observed_or_supplied_case: The actual S10 pass gate includes evidence while its enumerated equality checklist does not.
counterexample.failure_observation: A consumer limited to the enumerated checklist can leave evidence parity unchecked.
counterexample.same_problem_applicability: A schema-centered method can omit a source obligation while retaining the method's other structure.
counterexample.limitations: This is incomplete coverage, not inability of JSON to represent evidence; a consumer following the full gate can still catch drift. No runtime consumer failure is claimed.

attack_to_expand.assumption: The locally enumerated schema checks exhaust the human obligation.
attack_to_expand.opening: Derive checks from obligations independently of the preferred representation.
candidates: Add evidence and success_measure to an explicit obligation-parity table, retaining provenance for each.
Review a human-readable decision card directly against the brief.

findings.repair: Include evidence in the run's equality check; bind success measures to the outcome and check them explicitly.

findings.title: An evidence-generation route has an ambiguous missing-evidence stop
findings.classification: observed wording tension; execution consequence unproven
findings.observation: S07 is intended to investigate uncertain causal explanations. Every step, including experiment-harness, says to stop on missing causal evidence and return a gap and next evidence. Read literally as an entry condition, that can stop the very test intended to supply the evidence. Read as a prohibition on unsupported winners, it is coherent.

attack_to_expand.assumption: The same stop phrase works for framing, testing, and selection.
attack_to_expand.opening: Treat unavailable evidence as a typed state with more than one valid successor.
candidates: Run a feasible discriminating test when required setup is available.
Retain an explicit unresolved branch when the needed observation is unavailable.
Select a reversible provisional intervention only when the fixed constraints allow it.
attack_to_expand.test: Compare agent interpretations of a missing outcome observation versus a missing indispensable test input; the former should permit measurement and the latter should produce a gap.

findings.repair: Interpret the frozen stop as blocking unsupported conclusions; distinguish missing indispensable input from the outcome a test is intended to measure in execution records.

findings.title: The catalog can count construction obligations but cannot yet rank recurring benefit
findings.observation: The sixteen recipes contain 47 authored steps, provenance obligations, synthesis gates, and support owners. S11 names operating effort as an input but supplies no observed operating-cost or outcome dataset. Therefore neither full orchestration nor a smaller route can be declared globally dominant.

attack_to_expand.assumption: Completing more investigative artifacts implies a better eventual decision.
attack_to_expand.opening: Separate research completion from operational adoption and measure the cost borne by the decision owner.
candidates: Use a minimal causal decision card for routine decisions.
Escalate only for a named cross-layer contradiction.
Run a rich bounded investigation for cases where additional independent evidence can change the choice.
attack_to_expand.test: Record decision correctness and constraint preservation alongside active review time, handoffs, rework, and unresolved-owner load in the same cases.

findings.repair: Keep a Pareto set and owned cost residue. The present request to execute all strategies is a research deliverable, not evidence that every future task needs every strategy.

causal_experiment.status: proposed for parent execution; no results claimed by this role
causal_experiment.question: Does route structure improve intervention fit beyond the contribution of tool-independent causal evidence?

hypotheses.claim: More structured tools independently improve fit.
hypotheses.prediction: Within each evidence condition, structured reasoning preserves more constraints and chooses or correctly defers more cases than a plain causal decision card.

hypotheses.claim: Tool-independent discriminating observations are the primary contributor to fit.
hypotheses.prediction: Within each structure condition, supplying discriminating observations improves choices; adding structure at fixed evidence may tie or add burden.

logical_inversion.original: A rich structured workflow is necessary for fit.
logical_inversion.inversion: Under which evidence conditions does a plain causal record preserve fit with fewer handoffs?
logical_inversion.logic_limit: This is a counterfactual hypothesis, not the logically entailed inverse of an implication.

causal_experiment.design: Cross structure (plain causal card versus structured route) with evidence (capability description versus discriminating causal observations) on the same explicitly synthetic cases. Keep model, outcome, constraints, response budget, answer fields, and access fixed. Randomize case order across independent agents where practical.
case_families: An ownership bottleneck where more summaries cannot create decision authority.
A genuine information bottleneck where improved summaries can help an available decision owner.
A task-removal case where the obligation is unnecessary and removal preserves constraints.
An ambiguous case where the available observations cannot distinguish causes and deferral is correct.
causal_experiment.controlled_synthetic_rule: The case generator's stipulated causal structure is the scoring key for toy correctness; results establish performance on those stipulations, not the validity of the causal world model in production.
outcomes: correct causal target or appropriate inconclusive verdict
preservation of outcome and success measure
tokens or measured active review time and handoff count
causal_experiment.analysis: Compare evidence effect at fixed structure and structure effect at fixed evidence. Retain ties, mixed effects, and interactions. Do not combine dimensions into an invented weighted score.
confounders: Structured prompts may be longer and include more instructions.
Causal packets contain extra information by design; attribution to structure is invalid if they occur in only the structured arm.
A single native model family does not provide independent empirical populations.
Same-agent sequential cases create memory and order effects.
Synthetic cases may encode the author's favorite answer.
Rubric language can reward verbosity or recognize method labels.
Tool-access differences and unequal time budgets can decide the outcome.
honest_inconclusive_outcomes: Both arms choose the same valid mechanism with no discriminating difference.
The supplied observations do not distinguish the hypotheses.
Outcome correctness improves while operator burden also rises, leaving an incomparable pair.
Too few cases or one shared model make generalization unsupported.
An added framework changes output length but not any declared decision measure.
